 Punjab State Lottery Result Today LIVE, 2 November 2026: Dear 50 Beast Monday Winner & First Prize Number
 Personal Finance oi-Madhulika Pandey By Madhulika Pandey 
 Published: Monday, November 2, 2026, 16:56 [IST]
 Add as a preferred source on Google The Punjab State Dear 50 Beast Monday Weekly Lottery Result for November 2, 2026, is scheduled to be announced on Monday evening. The draw, numbered 67, is scheduled for 6:30 PM at the Camp Office in Ludhiana.
 The Dear 50 Beast lottery offers a first prize of Rs. 21 lakh, with several additional prize categories for ticket holders. Participants can check the winning numbers and prize details after the official draw announcement.
 The lottery ticket is priced at Rs. 50, and the draw features four series A, B, C and D with ticket numbers ranging from 00000 to 99999.
 Punjab Dear 50 Beast Lottery Prize Structure
 The Punjab Dear 50 Beast Monday lottery has multiple prize categories, ranging from the first prize of ₹21 lakh to smaller prizes of Rs. 100.
 First Prize: Rs. 21 lakh 
Consolation Prize: Rs. 10,000 
Second Prize: Rs. 9,000.
Third Prize: Rs. 3,000 
Fourth Prize: Rs. 2,000
Fifth Prize: Rs. 1,000 
Sixth Prize: Rs. 500
Seventh Prize: Rs. 100
 How to Claim Punjab State Dear 50 Beast Lottery Prize?
 Lottery winners of the Punjab State Dear 50 Beast Monday Weekly Lottery should follow the official prize claim procedure prescribed by the Punjab State Lotteries Directorate.
 Documents Required to Claim Punjab Lottery Prize
 Winners may be required to submit the following documents:
 Original winning lottery ticket, signed on the reverse.
 Prescribed Punjab State Lottery prize claim form.
 Aadhaar card or other valid identity proof.
 PAN card.
 Passport-size photographs.
 Bank account details, including account number and IFSC code.
 Cancelled cheque for bank account verification.
 Affidavit confirming ownership of the winning ticket.
 Attested photocopy of the winning ticket, as required by the authorities.
 Where to Submit the Punjab Lottery Claim?
 For major prizes, winners should contact the Directorate of Punjab State Lotteries, Chandigarh, to obtain the prescribed claim form and confirm the submission procedure.
